fit_budget.purpose: budgeted linear-family baseline for local candidate expansion while preserving full test evaluation

linear.input_contract: lagged EEG matrix, lags 0..50, target aligned after trim_valid_range
linear.selection_rule: no regularization; validation Pearson recorded as auxiliary metadata
linear.normalization: linear-family StandardScaler fitted on train split only

ridge.input_contract: lagged EEG matrix, lags 0..50, target aligned after trim_valid_range
ridge.selection_rule: choose alpha by validation Pearson after lag trimming
ridge.normalization: linear-family StandardScaler fitted on train split only

lasso.input_contract: lagged EEG matrix, lags 0..50, target aligned after trim_valid_range
lasso.normalization: linear-family StandardScaler fitted on train split only

elasticnet.input_contract: lagged EEG matrix, lags 0..50, target aligned after trim_valid_range
elasticnet.selection_rule: choose alpha and l1_ratio by validation Pearson
elasticnet.normalization: linear-family StandardScaler fitted on train split only

cca.input_contract: lagged EEG matrix, lags 0..50, target aligned after trim_valid_range
cca.selection_rule: choose PCA/component/reconstruction alpha by validation reconstruction correlation
cca.normalization: CCA x/y scalers fitted on train split only

fcnn.normalization: model-local train split handling; no test-fitted scaler

dnn.normalization: model-local train split handling; no test-fitted scaler

cnn.normalization: model-local train split handling; no test-fitted scaler

vlaai.normalization: model-local train split handling; no test-fitted scaler

happyquokka.input_contract: 10s EEG chunk at 64 Hz, g_con=false, no true envelope context input
happyquokka.normalization: model-local train split handling; no test-fitted scaler
